capabilities: Cycle between four Miku theme modes (MinimalMiku, Concert, NightNeon, SnowMiku) via ribbon or command
Open a Miku dashboard panel view with ASCII decoration presets
Show optional status bar, banner, quote, and profile widgets
Adjust reduced-motion and glow intensity settings
Apply bundled palette styling from styles.css without a separate theme
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; README includes a no-audio policy and trademark/copyright disclaimers for fan-inspired visuals.
problem: Obsidian's built-in themes offer no Miku-inspired looks, and styling such palettes normally requires installing a separate Appearance theme.
summary: Theme plugin that applies Hatsune Miku-inspired color modes with optional dashboard widgets and bundled CSS styling.
